widgets.name: Active Sessions (5m)
widgets.description: Sessions active in the last 5 minutes

visualization.raw: SELECT count(*) FROM Span WHERE attributes.session.id IS NOT NULL AND timestamp > ago(5m)
SELECT count(*) FROM Span WHERE name LIKE 'tool.%'

widgets.name: Sessions per Model
widgets.description: Breakdown of sessions by model type

visualization.raw: SELECT count(*) FROM Span WHERE attributes.gen_ai.request.model IS NOT NULL FACET attributes.gen_ai.request.model

widgets.name: Session Success Rate
widgets.description: Ratio of idle sessions to created sessions

visualization.raw: SELECT (filter(count(*), WHERE name = 'session.idle') / filter(count(*), WHERE name = 'session.created')) * 100 FROM Span
SELECT count(*) FROM Span WHERE name = 'agent.session.primary' TIMESERIES AUTO

SELECT count(*) as calls, count(filter(*, WHERE attributes.tool.error = 1)) as errors, round(count(*)/count(*), 2) as error_rate, attributes.tool.name FROM Span WHERE name = 'tool.execute.after' FACET attributes.tool.name ORDER BY calls DESC LIMIT 20
